name: IR Playbook - Ransomware / Mass Encryption
description: Contain, Investigate, Communicate steps for ransomware/mass encryption detection.

fields.title: Contain: Isolate Host
fields.description: Query Kibana for process list and use Wazuh active response to isolate host (block network).

fields.title: Investigate: Timeline
fields.description: Use Kibana Timeline to reconstruct attack chain and gather evidence (processes, network, file events).

fields.title: Communicate: Notify CISO
fields.description: Use the pre-defined email template to notify relevant stakeholders with case summary.
